summary: The best week on this account since early August, and the first in four that was not 100% billing traffic. Two long-running failures finally moved: (1) the Aug 1-14 wire mess closed - Stephski confirmed receipt on 08-30, and the answer to last week's open question is that the 08-25 wires were ADDITIONAL money, not resends, leaving Liza $2,499.59 in credit which was rolled into the new invoice; (2) Vivek, the Meta Support Rep Derrek introduced on 2026-07-29, posted his first-ever messages in this chat after 32 days of silence, triggered by Mayson escalating twice with '@fonta'. Mica also broke an 18-day reel-inspo gap. Against that: Liza disclosed that ALL of the backup Instagram accounts ALTR runs for her have been deleted or suspended ('All Instagram I gave you guys got deleted. Any news with recovery's?'), and at window close there is still no status on any of the three. Vivek told her 'Check dms', she asked 'Which dms ?', and nobody answered for 51 hours until Mayson said 'Check his telegram'. She also posted three Instagram usernames and plaintext passwords directly into this ~20-person group chat at Vivek's request, and a ChatDeleteUser event fired two days later. Derrek has now been silent for 31 days and the Phone Farm updates he promised on 2026-08-01 are 27 days past their own stated window. Note the timing collision: Mayson asked her to commit to 7 fresh reels a week for the content Drive in the same conversation in which she reported the accounts that content feeds are gone.

health.rationale: +9 from 57. The single biggest drag - an unreconciled ~$2,433 gap and three unanswered client messages - is fully closed, and the resolution was in her favour ($2,499.59 credit). Engagement recovered hard: 36 messages vs 11 last week, 17 team messages vs 2, and four different ALTR people posted. Vivek activating and Mica resuming cadence both clear items that had been rotting in state for a month. Held back from higher by: three IG accounts still deleted/suspended with zero status reported, a 51-hour dead thread on 'Which dms ?', plaintext account credentials sitting in a group chat, Derrek at 31 days silent with the Phone Farm promise 27 days past window, and the fact that Stephski still did not volunteer the credit figure - Liza had to ask 'How much did you deduct babe?', the fifth consecutive cycle where she has had to ask for a number.
